scope: Declared 146 E to 142 E offshore north-New-Guinea surface reference reach, ordered northwestward for the trade-wind convention. Both gates and every vertex are selected by OSW. Excludes southeast coastal continuation, Vitiaz Strait, Halmahera branches and the deeper New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent; not a whole-current endpoint or observed axis.

time_convention: Figure 8.6 depicts April-November trade-wind circulation; December-March northwest monsoon reverses the surface flow. This editorial sketch is not dated geometry or a monthly climatological axis. The year-round northwest flow below 200 m is excluded.
